title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
title_zh: Agent Error Dataset：扩展至 50,000 对错误诊断样本，用于失败分析与错误感知后训练
abstract_en: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.
abstract_zh: 一次失败的 LLM agent rollout 所包含的信息远不止最终奖励，还包括 agent 可观察到的状态、采取的动作以及环境反馈。要将这些经验用于学习，需要识别应被修改的决策，并验证一个具体的替代方案。本文提出 Agent Error Dataset（AED），包含来自 9,961 个源任务、33 个环境、19 个 harness 家族和 23 个策略模型的 50,228 对错误诊断样本，覆盖文本型 agent 系统。数据集保留源轨迹与执行元数据，支持跨设置的失败分析和无需重跑原始 rollout 的重新诊断。作者提出五阶段 Agentic Error-to-Training（AET）流程：收集自然失败，生成诊断与修正方案，并基于记录证据进行核验。在支持 replay 的场景中，研究者还在相同 checkpoint 和匹配执行设置下，将修正方案与原始动作重试进行比较，随后分别构建用于错误诊断和 actor 恢复的训练视图。在 3,062 对匹配 replay 样本中，首次提出的修正方案将 verifier 通过率从 18.4% 提升至 51.1%，提高 32.7 个百分点。使用独立冻结的诊断数据版本进行微调时，在 1,656 个源任务上训练完整诊断模型，使 Qwen3-8B 与内部 teacher 标签的精确步骤一致率从 47.2% 提升至 63.6%，该结果为三个随机种子的平均值，并在 943 个案例的留出集上评估。对比中表现最强的 prompting 基线为 54.7%，且随着训练集规模按四个阶段增加，平均一致率持续提升。在单随机种子下的 actor 训练配方比较中，仅使用动作修复训练在 WebShop-lite 上比仅使用成功样本训练高出 6.67 个百分点。
key_points_zh: Agent Error Dataset（AED）汇集50,228对错误诊断样本，覆盖9,961个任务、33个环境、19个harness家族和23个策略模型。
五阶段 Agentic Error-to-Training（AET）流程利用失败轨迹、执行元数据和证据核验，生成可验证的诊断与动作修正方案。
在3,062对匹配 replay 样本中，首次修正方案将 verifier 通过率由18.4%提升至51.1%，提高32.7个百分点。
完整诊断微调使 Qwen3-8B 与内部 teacher 标签的精确步骤一致率由47.2%提升至63.6%，且数据规模扩大时持续受益。
在 WebShop-lite 上，动作修复训练较仅使用成功样本训练高出6.67个百分点，表明失败经验可有效支持 actor 恢复。

llm_assessment.comment: AED is a highly reusable trajectory-error dataset and replay-based training pipeline that directly supports diagnosis, recovery, and agent improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: AED提供了高度可复用的轨迹错误数据集和回放训练流程，直接支持诊断、恢复与智能体改进。
